verified.value: Tony McEvoy confirmed the Melbourne Cup defence remains on; Turnbull Stakes and Cox Plate were the likely stepping stones at publication.
Jamie Melham retained the Melbourne Cup ride. Half Yours had a Flemington 1000m jump-out in August and was scheduled to resume in the Group 1 Makybe Diva Stakes over 1600m on 12 September.
The Makybe Diva Stakes was described by the stable as a stepping stone toward the Cox Plate and Melbourne Cup; Flemington trackwork on 8 September was reported positively.
